_note: Tokenized-instrument pre-trade eligibility (Workstream P-3, AUR-PRETRADE-REG-001 §V). Before releasing a tokenized/native-digital instrument, pre-trade verifies three things: (a) ISSUER AUTHORIZATION — the issuer is authorized under the applicable regime (MiCA CASP register / GENIUS stablecoin issuer register); MiCA hard authorization deadline was 2026-07-01, non-compliant issuers face delisting. (b) SUPPORTED SETTLEMENT RAIL — the instrument settles on a rail Cato supports (the live atomic-vs-FICC viability decision is Cato's at settlement time; pre-trade only checks a viable rail EXISTS). (c) CUSTODY-OBJECT CLASS — the instrument maps to a known custody-object category (AUR-CUSTODY-OBJ-001). Fictional register. The source_path loader seam is the integration point for a live MiCA/GENIUS register feed. Editing is a doctrine event. Clearing/settlement execution remains Atreides; this gate governs pre-trade ENTRY eligibility only.
_field_note: Decision fields consumed: token_issuer_id (key into issuer_register), settlement_rail (one of supported_rails), custody_class (one of known_custody_classes, or taken from the register entry if absent). Status semantics: AUTHORIZED -> eligible; PENDING -> HOLD (authorization in progress); REVOKED/absent -> BLOCK (non-compliant/unknown issuer, MiCA delisting).
